programme.title: In bed met Olly / In bed met Olly
programme.desc: A famous guest spends the night with Olly Wannabe for ten weeks. But there is little sleep in the house... / Tien weken lang blijft een bekende gast slapen bij Olly Wannabe. Maar van slapen komt weinig in huis ...

programme.title: Ninja Express / Ninja Express

programme.title: Lou / Lou
programme.desc: Animated series about the daily life of the 12-year-old girl Lou, who lives with her single mother and cat in a big city. Based on the comic series of the same name by artist Julien Neel. / Animatieserie over het dagelijkse leven van het 12-jarige meisje Lou, die met haar alleenstaande moeder en kat in een grote stad woont. Gebaseerd op de gelijknamige stripreeks van tekenaar Julien Neel.

programme.title: Dodo / Dodo
programme.desc: Comic animated series about the daily experiences of 11-year-old student Joe Connolly. / Komische animatieserie over de dagelijkse belevenissen van de 11-jarige scholier Joe Connolly.

programme.title: De Faker / De Faker
programme.desc: At first glance it seems like an ordinary family, but something is not right. One of the family members has been replaced by an actor. But who is that? It is played by: The boys' team: Niek Roozen, Juvat Westendorp and Klaas van der Eerden. The girls' team: Marije Zuurveld, Stephanie van Eer and Shelly Sterk. / Op het oog lijkt het een doodgewoon gezin maar er klopt iets niet. Een van de gezinsleden is vervangen door een acteur. Maar wie dat is? Er wordt gespeeld door: Het jongensteam: Niek Roozen, Juvat Westendorp en Klaas van der Eerden. Het meidenteam: Marije Zuurveld, Stephanie van Eer en Shelly Sterk.

programme.title: Hello croquette / Hallo Kroket
programme.desc: Daily live show in which the KETNET wrappers draw you into the world of KETNET and that of the Ketnetters. Verwacht je aan bekende gasten, zotte primeurs, leuke optredens, spannende spelletjes en nog zo veel meer. HALLO KROKET!

programme.title: #IkLome / #LikeMe
programme.desc: Director Wolfs gives Caro's class a detention study on Saturday. Everyone tries to make the best of it. Notably absent is Vince, who was allowed to stay home to help his parents, because they have a journalist coming over. / Directeur Wolfs geeft de klas van Caro strafstudie op zaterdag. Iedereen probeert er het beste van te maken. Opvallende afwezige is Vince, die thuis mocht blijven om zijn ouders te helpen, want zij krijgen een journalist over de vloer.

De reeks is gebaseerd op de Noorse web only dramareeks Jenter.

programme.title: How hard can it be? / Hoe moeilijk kan het zijn?
programme.desc: What makes the food in star restaurants so special (and expensive)? Because follow a recipe: everyone can do that. How hard can it be to cook a star dish? / Wat maakt het eten in sterrenrestaurants nu zo speciaal (en duur)? Want een recept volgen: dat kan toch iedereen. Hoe moeilijk kan het zijn om een sterrengerecht te koken?

programme.title: The Council of Soekie / De Raad van Soekie
programme.desc: Soekie's big dream comes true: her great idol, the Prime Minister, comes to visit the school. Soekie is allowed to give her a tour of the school. But Soekie is so starstruck that just when she looks at the Prime Minister, she starts sweating very hard and can't get her words out. She fears that she will die in front of the minister. / De grote droom van Soekie komt uit: haar grote idool, de eerste minister, komt de school bezoeken. Soekie mag haar een rondleiding geven door de school. Maar Soekie is zo starstruck dat ze alleen nog maar bij het zien naar de eerste minister, heel hard begint te zweten en niet uit haar woorden komt. Ze vreest dat ze zal afgaan voor de ogen van de minister.

programme.title: The Hoppers / De Hoppers
programme.desc: Arno is a bit in the pit because he has never had a love and has never kissed. He is in love with Olivia, but he has never dared to say this. Geert encourages Arno to express his feelings to Olivia. Arno puts on his bad shoes and tries to conquer Olivias Hart. Everyone is surprised when that suddenly seems to work. / Arno zit wat in de put omdat hij nog nooit een lief heeft gehad en nog nooit heeft gekust. Hij is verliefd op Olivia, maar hij heeft dit nog nooit durven zeggen. Geert moedigt Arno aan om zijn gevoelens te uiten aan Olivia. Arno trekt zijn stoute schoenen aan en probeert Olivias hart te veroveren. Iedereen is verbaasd wanneer dat plots lijkt te lukken.

programme.title: Animal doctors 24/7 / Dierendokters 24/7
programme.desc: After his fall down the stairs, the prognosis for bulldog Walter is not so good. Hopefully back surgery can get him back on his feet. 3 bearded dragons are brought into the special animal department. They come for a check-up because they have lost a lot of weight. Stallion MNM is brought to the faculty in pain. He has an inguinal hernia and urgently needs surgery. / Na zijn val van de trap is de prognose voor bulldog Walter niet zo goed. Hopelijk kan een rugoperatie hem opnieuw op de been krijgen. Op de afdeling bijzondere dieren worden 3 baardagamen binnengebracht. Ze komen voor een controle, want ze zijn sterk vermagerd. Hengst MNM wordt briesend van de pijn naar de faculteit gebracht. Hij heeft een liesbreuk en moet dringend geopereerd worden.

programme.title: Hotel Romantics / Hotel Romantiek
programme.desc: 12 women and 12 men over 65 look for the love of their lives. They have 8 days to get to know each other in beautiful Poland. Gloria, Sven and Philippe do everything they can to help them. The 12 women get the chance to settle down in Hotel Romantiek for a while, before the men get to know them up close. After an adventurous walk in the woods, the first couple can go to the swan. There it spends the night at the most romantic location in Poland. / 12 vrouwen en 12 mannen van boven de 65 gaan op zoek naar de liefde van hun leven. Ze hebben 8 dagen de tijd om elkaar te leren kennen in het prachtige Polen. Gloria, Sven en Philippe doen er alles aan om hen daarbij te helpen. De 12 vrouwen krijgen de kans om zich al even te nestelen in Hotel Romantiek, voor de mannen hen van wel erg dichtbij leren kennen. Na een avontuurlijke boswandeling mag er een eerste koppel naar de zwaan. Daar brengt het de nacht door op de meest romantische locatie van Polen.

programme.title: Cops / Flikken
programme.desc: Britt informs Danny of the popping up of Luther Cosanni. Despite Dannys Protest, Britt Luther decides to confront only: after all these years she wants to hear the truth about the death of her husband Mark. Tony tries to find out what is going on with Britt and also what happened between Britt and Nadine. Pasmans has agreed with Lidy and a nervous Raymond is waiting for the verdict. / Britt brengt Danny op de hoogte van het opduiken van Luther Cosanni. Ondanks Dannys protest besluit Britt Luther alleen te confronteren: ze wil na al die jaren de waarheid horen over de dood van haar echtgenoot Mark. Tony probeert uit te vinden wat er met Britt aan de hand is en ook wat er tussen Britt en Nadine is gebeurd. Pasmans heeft afgesproken met Lidy en een nerveuze Raymond wacht op het verdict.

programme.desc: Frederic and Ilse live as a newly formed family in Millen, Riemst. They do this in Frederic's parental home, which used to be a well-known local shop. But all the children have left home and that is now much too big. Frederic wants to split it into two apartments and spend his old age there. But Ilse is terrified of renovation work and all the dust that it entails. She prefers a brand new, spotless and ready-to-move-in apartment. It will not be an easy task for Ken and Kristien. / Frederic en Ilse wonen als nieuw samengesteld gezin in Millen, Riemst. Dat doen ze in het ouderlijk huis van Frederic, vroeger een gekende buurtwinkel. Maar alle kinderen zijn het huis uit en dat is nu dus veel te groot. Frederic wil het opsplitsen in twee appartementen en daar zijn oude dag doorbrengen. Maar Ilse is als de dood voor verbouwingswerken en al het stof dat dit met zich meebrengt. Zij voelt meer voor een splinternieuw, kraaknet en instapklaar appartement. Het wordt geen eenvoudige opdracht voor Ken en Kristien.

programme.title: How hard can it be? / Hoe moeilijk kan het zijn?
programme.desc: There are wolves again in Belgium and everywhere you will come across photos and videos. From wolves on the street, even chill in the garden! How hard can it be to spot a wolf? / Er zijn weer wolven in België en overal kom je fotos en filmpjes tegen. Van wolven op straat, tot zelfs chill in de tuin! Hoe moeilijk kan het zijn om een wolf te spotten?

programme.title: The Council of Soekie / De Raad van Soekie
programme.desc: Bully Kenji makes the WCS unsafe. Pedro decides that Kenji must be locked up every playing time. Soekie does not agree, but notices that everyone can go back to the toilet and accepts it. Aiko is late for school. Just like Kenji, she has a red backpack. For Pedro this is proof that every student with a red backpack is a potential criminal. He wants to preventively locking every student with a red backpack preventively so that they cannot commit criminal facts. / Bully Kenji maakt de wcs onveilig. Pedro beslist dat Kenji elke speeltijd opgesloten moet worden. Soekie is het er niet mee eens, maar merkt dat iedereen terug naar het toilet kan en legt er zich bij neer. Aiko komt te laat op school. Net zoals Kenji heeft zij een rode rugzak. Voor Pedro is dit het bewijs dat elke leerling met een rode rugzak een potentiële crimineel is. Hij wil elke leerling met een rode rugzak elke speeltijd preventief opsluiten zodat ze geen criminele feiten kunnen plegen.

programme.title: The Hoppers / De Hoppers
programme.desc: Jackie is proud of her homemade rocket, which she has named Rudi. She is ready to take off, but then it turns out that someone has broken Rudi. Jackie is sure there is foul play and wants to know who killed Rudi. She and Esra look for the perpetrator. All Hoppers have a motive and are therefore suspicious. / Jackie is trots op haar zelfgemaakte raket, die ze Rudi heeft genoemd. Ze is klaar om ermee op te stijgen, maar dan blijkt dat iemand Rudi stuk heeft gemaakt. Jackie is er zeker van dat er kwaad opzet in het spel zit en wil weten wie Rudi vermoord heeft. Ze gaat samen met Esra op zoek naar de dader. Alle Hoppers hebben een motief en zijn dus verdacht.

programme.desc: "Fundus" is a TV story format whose themes are BH. Cultural and historical heritage, unknown stories and details from our heritage, but also a reminder of valuable cultural treasure that preserve museums across the country. programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V / Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: The animated series follows the exciting adventures of the bold boy Yuye Sakaki, whose father disappeared three years ago. The boy's great dream is to go to his father's footsteps and become a top duelist. After he suddenly discovers a new technique to invoke a monster, that dream slowly begins to be its reality. / Animirana serija prati uzbudljive avanture odvažnog dječaka Yuye Sakakija, čiji je otac nestao prije tri godine. Dječakov veliki san je poći očevim stopama i postati vrhunski duelist. Nakon što nenadano otkrije novu tehniku za prizivanje čudovišta, taj san polako počinje biti njegova stvarnost.

programme.title: The mummies / Mumijevi
programme.desc: They are seemingly ordinary family .. Licensees to Nile horses and live in the Mummy Valley. They bring numerous ordinary and unusual adventures, both in the house and on travel and trips, where they get to know various interesting beings and people. / Oni su naizgled obična porodica.. liče na nilske konje i žive u dolini Mumijeva. Oni donose brojne obične i neobične dogodovštine, kako u kući, tako i na putovanjima i izletima, gdje upoznaju razna interesantna bića i osobe.

programme.title: Slugterra / Slugterra
programme.desc: Fifteen -year -old Eli Shane is in life all usually, except one thing. Comes from the Shane family. Each member of that family traveled to the Underground of Slugterre to protect the special world of Slugs. Now it is a turn on the Elijah, to visit the underground and to protect it from the enemy, whether he is ready or not. Eli is persistent in the intention of becoming a hero, in order to manage to resist the forces of evil. Together with trixie friends, cords and print, he must carefully collect and train small animals, different snails, who have the ability to transform into magical monsters. / Petnaestogodišnjem Eliju Shaneu je u životu sve obično, osim jedne stvari. Dolazi iz porodice Shane. Svaki član te porodice putovao je u podzemlje Slugterre, kako bi zaštitio posebni svijet slug-ova. Sada je red na Elija, da posjeti podzemlje i da ga zaštiti od neprijatelja, bio on spreman ili ne. Eli je ustrajan u namjeri da postane heroj, kako bi se uspio oduprijeti silama zla. Zajedno sa prijateljima Trixie, Kordom i Prontom mora pažljivo sakupljati i trenirati male životinje, različite puževe, koji imaju sposobnost transformirati se u magična čudovišta.

programme.title: Victims of love / Žrtve ljubavi
programme.desc: After a tumultuous meeting with the brand, Silvia returns home desperate and sad. She admits to her husband that she talked to him. Obsessed with a woman's betrayal, Corrado first moved away from her loved ones, and then a drink. During the night, drunk fell into Maddalen's room and tries to rape it, then throw it out of the villa. Giosue realizes that Brando is no longer the same since Silvia had visited him, so he confided in Lucrezia. The piece of the rock breaks off as Mizzi, Hans and Lucrezia walk the path for which Brando wanted to close. However, with Giosue's help, Brando will be able to save the lives of several people. / Nakon burnog susreta s Brandom, Silvia se vraća kući očajna i tužna. Priznaje suprugu da je razgovarala s njim. Opsjednut ženinom izdajom, Corrado je prvo udalji od njenih najmilijih, a onda se oda piću. Tokom noći, pijan upadne u Maddaleninu sobu i pokuša je silovati, a onda je izbaci iz vile. Giosue shvati da Brando više nije isti otkad mu je Silvia bila u posjeti, pa to povjeri Lucreziji. Komad stijene se odlomi dok se Mizzi, Hans i Lucrezia šeću stazom za koju je Brando htio da se zatvori. Brando će ipak, uz Giosueovu pomoć, uspjeti spasiti živote nekoliko ljudi.

The team of Radio and Television of Bosnia and Herzegovina was also at the concert, and the report was prepared by Nedim Puris. / Hanka Paldum proslavila je 50 godina uspješne karijere koncertom u prepunoj zagrebačkoj dvorani "Vatroslava Lisinskog". Mnogobrojna publika i gosti uživali su u bezvremenskim hitovima "kraljice narodne muzike i sevdaha" a gosti na koncertu su bili Doris Dragović, Žak Houdek i Leon Grd. I ekipa Radiotelevizije Bosne i Hercegovine bila je na koncertu, a reportažu je pripremio Nedim Puriš.

programme.desc: Maddalena is forced to leave Villa Corradi. Silvia wants to help her and gives her a valuable emerald necklace, with the advice to sell her and thus help her family. But thanks to Mrs. Maffei and engineer Corradi, that advice will be fatal to her. After Tommaso learns that they have thrown out his fiancée out of the villa and he decides to leave his furniture teachers and tells his aunt. Silvia is desperate and continues to take excessive doses of opiates. Brando, with Giosue's help, managed to save many of the mountain avalanche. Now everyone looks at him like a hero. But something broke in his heart, and his love for Sylvia turned into indignation. Only near his friends Giosue and Lucrezia manages to soften his pain somewhat. In Carrara, Guendalina reveals to Albert a secret that can destroy Annibale Lucchesi, but Alberto Corradi does not want to abuse it in his advantage. Guenalina still decides to inform the journalists about this. / Maddalena je prisiljena napustiti vilu Corradi. Silvia joj želi pomoći i daje joj vrijednu ogrlicu od smaragda, uz savjet da je proda i tako pomogne svojoj porodici. No zahvaljujući gđici Maffei i inženjeru Corradiju, taj će se savjet za nju pokazati kobnim. Nakon što Tommaso sazna da su njegovu zaručnicu izbacili iz vile i on odluči napustiti svoje namještenje učitelja i to saopštava svojoj tetki. Silvia je očajna i nastavlja uzimati pretjerane doze opijata. Brando je, uz Giosueovu pomoć, uspio spasiti mnoge od planinske lavine. Sad ga svi gledaju kao junaka. No nešto se prelomilo u njegovom srcu, a njegova se ljubav prema Silviji pretvorila u ogorčenje. Samo u blizini svojih prijatelja Giosuea i Lucrezije donekle uspijeva ublažiti svoju bol. U Carrari, Guendalina otkriva Albertu tajnu koja može uništiti Annibalea Lucchesija, no Alberto Corradi ne želi zloupotrijebiti to u svoju korist. Guendalina svejedno odluči o svemu tome obavijestiti novinare.

programme.title: Tri mace / Tri mace
programme.desc: Animated series for the youngest about adventures of three fearless kittens who are always ready for new challenges. The cheerful kitten biscuit lives with his big brother Chok and little sister Lola. Their days are filled with fun and socializing with best friends. They like to play, eat sweets, and explore unknown phenomena and objects that surround them. Every day, they embark on a new adventure, and thanks to the wise advice of their caring parents, they solve all obstacles and learn numerous life lessons. / Animirana serija za najmlađe o pustolovinama tri neustrašiva mačića koji su uvijek spremni za nove izazove. Veseli mačić Keksić živi s velikim bratom Čokom i malenom sestrom Lolom. Njihovi dani ispunjeni su zabavom i druženjem s najboljim prijateljima. Vole se igrati, jesti slatkiše, te istraživati nepoznate pojave i predmete koji ih okružuju. Svaki dan upuštaju se u novu pustolovinu, a zahvaljujući mudrim savjetima njihovih brižnih roditelja, rješavaju sve prepreke i uče brojne životne lekcije.

The effect develops amid the great vineyards of the picturesque province of Tuscany. / Това е една история за убийство, заговор, кръв и тайни, но преди всичко за любов - една невъзможна любов между двама млади, Аурора Тавиани и Алесандро Монфорте.Аурора Тавиани, несправедливо обвинена в убийството на Лука Монфорте, е освободена от затвора след 8-годишна присъда и се прибира в къщата на баба си.... programme.title: Basketball: League Endes: 1 Circle: Unique - Bilbao Basket / Баскетбол: Лига Ендеса: 1 кръг: Уникаха - Билбао Баскет
programme.desc: The Spanish Basketball League was founded in 1957 as the National League and received its current format in 1983, when the ACB organization took control of the competition. According to the scoring, the ACB League is one of the top three European leagues. Currently, 18 teams are participating in the league, playing with each other twice during the season. The team with the most titles won is Real Madrid, but tightly followed by Barcelona. The Spanish Championship gave us some of the greatest players and coaches in the world throughout history. / Испанската баскетболна лига е основана през 1957 г. като Национална лига и получава настоящия си формат през 1983 г., когато организацията ACB поема контрола над състезанието. Според точкуването Лига ACB е една от трите най-добри европейски лиги. В момента в лигата участват 18 отбора, които играят помежду си два пъти през сезона. Отборът с най-много спечелени титли е Реал Мадрид, но плътно следван от Барселона. Испанското първенство ни даде някои от най-великите играчи и треньори в света през цялата история.

programme.title: Football: World Cup qualifiers 2026: Oman - Qatar / Футбол: Квалификации за Световно първенство 2026: Оман - Катар
programme.desc: National teams from different continents compete in groups and playoffs to win a place among the best to fight for the world title. The qualifications are divided into Confederations - Europe (UEFA), South America (CONMEBOL), Asia (AFC), Africa (Kaf), North and Central America (Konkacaf) and Oceania (OFK). Each region has its own format, with matches being held for several years. / Националните отбори от различни континенти се състезават в групи и плейофи, за да спечелят място сред най-добрите, които ще се борят за световната титла. Квалификациите са разделени по конфедерации – Европа (УЕФА), Южна Америка (КОНМЕБОЛ), Азия (АФК), Африка (КАФ), Северна и Централна Америка (КОНКАКАФ) и Океания (ОФК). Всеки регион има свой формат, като мачовете се провеждат в продължение на няколко години.

Като най-високото ниво на професионалния футбол, тя привлича вниманието както на местни, така и на международни фенове. Успехът в Суперлигата отваря вратите към престижните европейски клубни турнири, където гръцките отбори имат шанса да се докажат срещу най-добрите отбори в Европа.

programme.title: Football: League 1 in France: 7 round: FC Paris - Lorien / Футбол: Лига 1 на Франция: 7 кръг: ФК Париж - Лориен
programme.desc: League 1 consists of 20 teams that compete against each other in 38 rounds, changed. The French Championship dates from 1892, the so -called Amateur League until 1929. In 1932, the foundations of professionally organized football in France were laid. The French Division 1 includes in its first season 1932-33 the following teams, divided into two groups: Club France, Excelsior, Ier, Lille, Marseille, Muluz, Nice, Nim, Racing Paris, Ale, Antib, Khan, are Paris, Fiv, Montz, Red Star, Ren and Sosho. In recent years, much later, the formed club Paris Saint-Germain has been an absolute dominant on the home stage, but before that, Lyon, Marseille, Bordeaux, Monaco, Nan, Saint Etienne, Reim, Nice, Lance and more have also had many successes. / Лига 1 се състои от 20 отбора, които се състезават един срещу друг в 38 кръга, на разменено гостуване. Френският шампионат датира от 1892, така нареченета Аматьорска лига до 1929. През 1932 се полагат основите на професионално организраният футбол във Франция. Френската Дивизия 1 включва в своя първи сезон 1932-33 следните отбори, разделени в две групи: Клуб Франсе, Екселсиор, Иер, Лил, Марсилия, Мюлуз, Ница, Ним, Расинг Париж, Сет, Але, Антиб, Кан, СА Париж, Фив, Метц, Монпелие, Ред Стар, Рен и Сошо. През последните години доста по-късно сформирания клуб Пари Сен Жермен е абсолютен доминатор на домашната сцена, но преди това много успехи са имали също Лион, Марсилия, Бордо, Монако, Нан, Сен Етиен, Рейм, Ница, Ланс и др.

programme.title: Basketball: Spain Super Cup: semifinal: Unique - Valencia / Баскетбол: Суперкупа на Испания: Полуфинал: Уникаха - Валенсия
programme.desc: The Super Cup of Spain is an annual basketball tournament that opens the season in the country. It features the ACB League Champion, the King's Cup winner, the current Super Cup winner and another team, usually the host or a high -rated team. The tournament is held in the Final Four format with semi -finals and the final within a weekend. It offers fans the first derbies between leading Spanish clubs such as Real Madrid, Barcelona and Valencia and serves as a prelude to the new season. / Суперкупата на Испания е ежегоден баскетболен турнир, който открива сезона в страната. В него участват шампионът на Лига ACB, носителят на Купата на краля, настоящият победител в Суперкупата и още един отбор, обикновено домакинът или тим с висок рейтинг. Турнирът се провежда по формат "финална четворка" с полуфинали и финал в рамките на един уикенд. Той предлага на феновете първите дербита между водещите испански клубове като Реал Мадрид, Барселона и Валенсия и служи като прелюдия към новия сезон.

programme.title: The Promise / La Promesa
programme.desc: La Proses - (S04, E41, feature series, Spain, 2024) In 1913, while Europe is ruled by unrest, life on the noble estate of LA Promess owned by the Luján family cannot be more peaceful - at least it seems. The family is preparing to celebrate one of the most important events in Spanish surplus society - the wedding of Tomás, the eldest son of Count Luján and the daughter of one of the most comfortable families in the country. However, the Luján family knows that this is a contracted marriage that the family should save from financial ruin. In the meantime, the enigmatic young Jana (20) begins to work on LA Promethew and helps as a maid during preparation for a wedding. As he wanders the building, he meets Manuel (23) the Counts of the youngest son and Tomás's half -brother. It is a meeting that will not be able to forget ... The Countess on the day of the wedding cannot hide her dissatisfaction since she wanted the groom to actually be her son Manuel. Her dissatisfaction is growing increasing, and after her outburst of anger, Jana gets fired. During the wedding, everything goes according to plan until Manuel performs a play with his plane double and shows incredible acrobatic skills, and the celebration is interrupted when he loses control and collapses not far from the property. Jana saw what happened and hurried to the scene to save Manuel. The Count offered Jani a generous award in gratitude, but she only asked to return her to work. The family does not know this, but Jana has a plan to avenge her mother who happened 15 years ago and wants to find her younger brother, who has been abducted the same evening. The only trail that Jana has to lead is to the magnificent building of La Provece, which he wants to infiltrate and find a murderer ... but also find love in Manuel's embrace. The next day another unfortunate event brings confusion to the property. Tomás was found dead. Sergeant Conrado, a member of the Civil Guard, is determined in his plan to find the killer. All evidence is referred to Jan because she is the last person with whom Tomás talked before his death. Obitelj se priprema za proslavu jednog od najvažnijih događaja u španjolskom viskom društvu - vjenčanje Tomása, najstarijeg sina grofa Lujána i kćeri jedne od najimućnijih obitelji u zemlji. programme.desc: Unit 414 - Schicksalstag 7. Oktober - Israels Soldatinnen und die, France, 2025) Documentary brings a unique view of the events from 7. October 2023, from the perspective of women who were at the first line. There were 23 of them. They called them "the eyes of the state." It is a unit 414 from Nahal oz military base. They warned, but the state did not listen to them. They saw what was preparing and were among the first victims. Today, guards that guard the border with Gaz require the truth to say and give us a cross section of today's Israeli society. If they had obeyed, attack 7. October could be prevented. Listening to their story, we talk about the attack, about the training of Hamas attackers who testified, about the disabilities of the Israeli Secret Service and the Government and the current lines in Israeli society, especially about the role of women in the army. R.: Michaël Darmon ... / Unit 414 - Schicksalstag 7. Oktober - Israels Soldatinnen und die Hamas - (dok. film, Francuska, 2025) Dokumentarni film donosi jedinstven pogled na događaje od 7. listopada 2023., iz perspektive žena koje su u tom trenutku bile na prvoj crti. Danas stražarice koje čuvaju granicu s Gazom zahtijevaju da se kaže istina i daju nam presjek današnjeg izraelskog društva. Da su ih poslušali, napad 7. listopada mogao se spriječiti. Slušajući njihovu priču, govorimo o napadu, o obuci Hamasovih napadača kojoj su svjedočile, o propustima izraelske tajne službe i vlade, o sudbini talaca te sadašnjim linijama napetosti u izraelskom društvu, osobito o ulozi žena u vojsci. programme.desc: La Proses - (S04, E41, feature series, Spain, 2024) In 1913, while Europe is ruled by unrest, life on the noble estate of LA Promess owned by the Luján family cannot be more peaceful - at least it seems. The family is preparing to celebrate one of the most important events in Spanish surplus society - the wedding of Tomás, the eldest son of Count Luján and the daughter of one of the most comfortable families in the country. However, the Luján family knows that this is a contracted marriage that the family should save from financial ruin. In the meantime, the enigmatic young Jana (20) begins to work on LA Promethew and helps as a maid during preparation for a wedding. As he wanders the building, he meets Manuel (23) the Counts of the youngest son and Tomás's half -brother. It is a meeting that will not be able to forget ... The Countess on the day of the wedding cannot hide her dissatisfaction since she wanted the groom to actually be her son Manuel. Her dissatisfaction is growing increasing, and after her outburst of anger, Jana gets fired. During the wedding, everything goes according to plan until Manuel performs a play with his plane double and shows incredible acrobatic skills, and the celebration is interrupted when he loses control and collapses not far from the property. Jana saw what happened and hurried to the scene to save Manuel. The Count offered Jani a generous award in gratitude, but she only asked to return her to work. The family does not know this, but Jana has a plan to avenge her mother who happened 15 years ago and wants to find her younger brother, who has been abducted the same evening. The only trail that Jana has to lead is to the magnificent building of La Provece, which he wants to infiltrate and find a murderer ... but also find love in Manuel's embrace. Dok luta zdanjem, susreće Manuela (23) grofova najmlađeg sina i Tomásova polubrata. Susret je to koji neće moći zaboraviti... Grofica na dan vjenčanja ne može skriti svoje nezadovoljstvo budući da je ona htjela da mladoženja zapravo bude njezin sin Manuel. Njezino nezadovoljstvo sve više raste, a nakon njezina ispada bijesa, Jana dobiva otkaz. Tijekom vjenčanja sve ide po planu sve dok Manuel ne izvede predstavu sa svojim avionom dvokrilcem te pokaže nevjerojatne akrobatske vještine, a slavlje se prekida kad izgubi kontrolu i sruši se nedaleko od imanja. Jana je vidjela što se dogodilo te pohita na mjesto nesreće kako bi spasila Manuela. Grof ponudi Jani velikodušnu nagradu u znak zahvalnosti, ali ona zatraži samo da je vrate na posao. Obitelj to ne zna, ali Jana cijelo vrijeme ima plan osvetiti ubojstvo svoje majke koje se dogodilo prije 15 godina te želi pronaći svog mlađeg brata koji je iste večeri otet. Jedini trag koji Jana ima vodi je do velebnog zdanja La Promesa u koje se želi infiltrirati te pronaći ubojicu... Ali i naći ljubav u Manuelovom zagrljaju. Idućeg dana još jedan nesretni događaj unese pomutnju na imanje. Tomás je pronađen mrtav. Narednik Conrado, pripadnik civilne garde, odlučan je u svom naumu da pronađe ubojicu. Svi dokazi upućuju na Janu jer ona je posljednja osoba s kojom je Tomás prije smrti razgovarao. R.: Miguel Cond...

programme.title: AGATHE CHRISTIE TRAVELS WITH SIR David Suchet / Putovanja Agathe Christie sa Sir Davidom Suchetom
programme.desc: Travels with Agatha Christie and Sir David Suchet - (E02, Tourism Program, England, 2025) In 1922, long before she became the best -selling author in the world, Agatha Christie embarked on an exciting world trip. Now, 100 years later, Sir David Suchet, who played Poirota, goes in her footsteps. On her incredible adventure, Agatha traveled through the then British Empire and visited South Africa, Australia, New Zealand and Canada, and spent a vacation in Hawaii. Armed with her trusted camera that will perpetuate her travels, Sir David will watch what she saw, what will give him insight into how that journey influenced her life and her literary work and will discover the unknown sides of her character. The way people understand Agath Christie is usually overshadowed by her public person she held in later life, when they considered her shy and withdrawn. But it was only a defensive wall that Agatha raised around her, and Sir David will discover her completely different character on her journey: a curious and carefree young woman who seems to become more and more self -conscious and more independent. In 1922, Agatha was only 31 years old and just started her literary journey. But by the time she returned home, they declared her one of the brightest young talents of the time. Agath's global journey happened because she and her husband Archie were part of a special mission in charge of promoting the upcoming exhibition of the British Empire. Held in London in 1924, designed to encourage the trade and strengthen ties among various nations. In addition to exploring Agath's past, Sir David will deal with the fascinating history of the countries she has visited. She will discover that the situation has changed in a hundred years since her journey and will see that different communities are struggling with complex inheritance of colonialism and how to transform it. R .: Catherine Abbott ... / Travels with Agatha Christie and Sir David Suchet - (E02, turistički program, Engleska, 2025) Godine 1922., mnogo prije nego što je postala najprodavanija autorica na svijetu, Agatha Christie krenula je na uzbudljivo svjetsko putovanje. Sada, 100 godina poslije, sir David Suchet, koji je glumio Poirota, ide njezinim stopama. Na svojoj nevjerojatnoj pustolovini Agatha je putovala kroz tadašnje Britansko Carstvo te je posjetila Južnu Afriku, Australiju, Novi Zeland i Kanadu, a provela je i odmor na Havajima. Naoružan svojim pouzdanim fotoaparatom kojim će ovjekovječiti svoja putovanja, sir David će gledati ono što je ona vidjela, što će mu pružiti uvid u to kako je to putovanje utjecalo na njezin život i njezin književni rad te će otkriti nepoznate strane njezina karaktera. Način na koji ljudi poimaju Agathu Christie obično je zasjenjen njezinom javnom osobom koju je održavala u kasnijem životu, kada su je smatrali sramežljivom i povučenom. No to je bio tek obrambeni zid koji je Agatha podigla oko sebe, a sir David će na svojem putovanju otkriti njezin sasvim drukčiji lik: znatiželjnu i bezbrižnu mladu ženu koja je, čini se, postajala sve samosvjesnija i neovisnija. Godine 1922. Agatha je imala samo 31 godinu i tek je počinjala svoje književno putovanje. No, do trenutka kada se vratila kući, proglasili su je jednim od najsjajnijih mladih talenata toga doba. Agathino globalno putovanje dogodilo se jer su ona i njezin suprug Archie bili dio posebne misije zadužene za promicanje nadolazeće Izložbe Britanskog Carstva. Održana u Londonu 1924. godine, osmišljena je kako bi potaknula trgovinu i ojačala veze među raznim narodima. Osim što će istražiti Agathinu prošlost, sir David će se baviti fascinantnom poviješću zemalja koje je posjetila. Otkrit će kako se situacija promijenila u sto godina od njezina putovanja i vidjet će kako se različite zajednice bore sa složenim nasljeđem kolonijalizma te kako ga transformiraju. R.: Catherine Abbott...

programme.title: The Promise / La Promesa
programme.desc: La Proses - (S04, E42, featured series, Spain, 2024) In 1913, while Europe is ruled by unrest, life on the noble estate of LA Provece owned by the Luján family cannot be more peaceful - at least it seems. The family is preparing to celebrate one of the most important events in Spanish surplus society - the wedding of Tomás, the eldest son of Count Luján and the daughter of one of the most comfortable families in the country. However, the Luján family knows that this is a contracted marriage that the family should save from financial ruin. In the meantime, the enigmatic young Jana (20) begins to work on LA Promethew and helps as a maid during preparation for a wedding. As he wanders the building, he meets Manuel (23) the Counts of the youngest son and Tomás's half -brother. It is a meeting that will not be able to forget ... The Countess on the day of the wedding cannot hide her dissatisfaction since she wanted the groom to actually be her son Manuel. Her dissatisfaction is growing increasing, and after her outburst of anger, Jana gets fired. During the wedding, everything goes according to plan until Manuel performs a play with his plane double and shows incredible acrobatic skills, and the celebration is interrupted when he loses control and collapses not far from the property. Jana saw what happened and hurried to the scene to save Manuel. The Count offered Jani a generous award in gratitude, but she only asked to return her to work. The family does not know this, but Jana has a plan to avenge her mother who happened 15 years ago and wants to find her younger brother, who has been abducted the same evening. The only trail that Jana has to lead is to the magnificent building of La Provece, which he wants to infiltrate and find a murderer ... but also find love in Manuel's embrace. The next day another unfortunate event brings confusion to the property. Tomás was found dead. Sergeant Conrado, a member of the Civil Guard, is determined in his plan to find the killer. All evidence is referred to Jan because she is the last person with whom Tomás talked before his death. R .: Miguel Conda ... / La promesa - (S04, E42, igrana serija, Španjolska, 2024) Godine 1913., dok Europom vladaju nemiri, život na plemićkom imanju La Promesa u vlasništvu obitelji Luján ne može biti mirniji - bar se tako čini. Obitelj se priprema za proslavu jednog od najvažnijih događaja u španjolskom viskom društvu - vjenčanje Tomása, najstarijeg sina grofa Lujána i kćeri jedne od najimućnijih obitelji u zemlji. Međutim, obitelj Luján zna kako je ovo ugovoreni brak koji bi obitelj trebao spasiti od financijske propasti. U međuvremenu, zagonetna mlada Jana (20) počinje raditi na La Promesi te kao sluškinja pomaže tijekom priprema za vjenčanje. Dok luta zdanjem, susreće Manuela (23) grofova najmlađeg sina i Tomásova polubrata. Susret je to koji neće moći zaboraviti... Grofica na dan vjenčanja ne može skriti svoje nezadovoljstvo budući da je ona htjela da mladoženja zapravo bude njezin sin Manuel. Njezino nezadovoljstvo sve više raste, a nakon njezina ispada bijesa, Jana dobiva otkaz. Tijekom vjenčanja sve ide po planu sve dok Manuel ne izvede predstavu sa svojim avionom dvokrilcem te pokaže nevjerojatne akrobatske vještine, a slavlje se prekida kad izgubi kontrolu i sruši se nedaleko od imanja. Jana je vidjela što se dogodilo te pohita na mjesto nesreće kako bi spasila Manuela. Grof ponudi Jani velikodušnu nagradu u znak zahvalnosti, ali ona zatraži samo da je vrate na posao. Obitelj to ne zna, ali Jana cijelo vrijeme ima plan osvetiti ubojstvo svoje majke koje se dogodilo prije 15 godina te želi pronaći svog mlađeg brata koji je iste večeri otet. Jedini trag koji Jana ima vodi je do velebnog zdanja La Promesa u koje se želi infiltrirati te pronaći ubojicu... Ali i naći ljubav u Manuelovom zagrljaju. Idućeg dana još jedan nesretni događaj unese pomutnju na imanje. Tomás je pronađen mrtav. Narednik Conrado, pripadnik civilne garde, odlučan je u svom naumu da pronađe ubojicu. Svi dokazi upućuju na Janu jer ona je posljednja osoba s kojom je Tomás prije smrti razgovarao. R.: Miguel Cond...

programme.title: Patina Mexican dishes / Patina meksička jela
programme.desc: Patis Mexican Table - (S12, E03, Educational Program, USA, 2023) The head of Pati Jinich again goes to the Mexican federal state of Yucatán, once the center of civilization of Maja, and explores the influence of this ancient people on its cultural and culinary heritage. He suffers returns to Southeast Mexico to get to know the widely known Yucatán state. The remains of the Mayan culture are still ubiquitous in everyday life, so it suffers to travel to the state to meet chefs, craftsmen and families who keep and continue that tradition. In the lively capital of Merida, it reveals that over the centuries, the Mayan cuisine has changed under the Spanish influence and became one of the best kitchens of the world ... / Patis Mexican Table - (S12, E03, obrazovni program, SAD, 2023) Voditeljica Pati Jinich ponovno odlazi u meksičku saveznu državu Yucatán, nekoć središte civilizacije Maja, te istražuje utjecaj ovog drevnog naroda na njezinu kulturnu i kulinarsku baštinu. Pati se vraća u jugoistočni Meksiko kako bi pobliže upoznala nadaleko poznatu državu Yucatán. Ostaci majanske kulture i danas su sveprisutni u svakodnevnom životu pa Pati putuje državom kako bi upoznala kuhare, obrtnike i obitelji koji čuvaju i nastavljaju tu tradiciju. U živahnom glavnom gradu Meridi otkriva kako se tijekom stoljeća majanska kuhinja mijenjala pod španjolskim utjecajem te postala jednom od najboljih kuhinja svijeta...

Armed with her trusted camera that will perpetuate her travels, Sir David will watch what she saw, what will give him insight into how that journey influenced her life and her literary work and will discover the unknown sides of her character. The way people understand Agath Christie is usually overshadowed by her public person she held in later life, when they considered her shy and withdrawn. But it was only a defensive wall that Agatha raised around her, and Sir David will discover her completely different character on her journey: a curious and carefree young woman who seems to become more and more self -conscious and more independent. In 1922, Agatha was only 31 years old and just started her literary journey. But by the time she returned home, they declared her one of the brightest young talents of the time. Agath's global journey happened because she and her husband Archie were part of a special mission in charge of promoting the upcoming exhibition of the British Empire. Held in London in 1924, designed to encourage the trade and strengthen ties among various nations. In addition to exploring Agath's past, Sir David will deal with the fascinating history of the countries she has visited. She will discover that the situation has changed in a hundred years since her journey and will see that different communities are struggling with complex inheritance of colonialism and how to transform it. R .: Catherine Abbott ... / Travels with Agatha Christie and Sir David Suchet - (E02, turistički program, Engleska, 2025) Godine 1922., mnogo prije nego što je postala najprodavanija autorica na svijetu, Agatha Christie krenula je na uzbudljivo svjetsko putovanje. Na svojoj nevjerojatnoj pustolovini Agatha je putovala kroz tadašnje Britansko Carstvo te je posjetila Južnu Afriku, Australiju, Novi Zeland i Kanadu, a provela je i odmor na Havajima. Naoružan svojim pouzdanim fotoaparatom kojim će ovjekovječiti svoja putovanja, sir David će gledati ono što je ona vidjela, što će mu pružiti uvid u to kako je to putovanje utjecalo na njezin život i njezin književni rad te će otkriti nepoznate strane njezina karaktera. Način na koji ljudi poimaju Agathu Christie obično je zasjenjen njezinom javnom osobom koju je održavala u kasnijem životu, kada su je smatrali sramežljivom i povučenom. No to je bio tek obrambeni zid koji je Agatha podigla oko sebe, a sir David će na svojem putovanju otkriti njezin sasvim drukčiji lik: znatiželjnu i bezbrižnu mladu ženu koja je, čini se, postajala sve samosvjesnija i neovisnija. Godine 1922. Agatha je imala samo 31 godinu i tek je počinjala svoje književno putovanje. No, do trenutka kada se vratila kući, proglasili su je jednim od najsjajnijih mladih talenata toga doba. Agathino globalno putovanje dogodilo se jer su ona i njezin suprug Archie bili dio posebne misije zadužene za promicanje nadolazeće Izložbe Britanskog Carstva. Održana u Londonu 1924. godine, osmišljena je kako bi potaknula trgovinu i ojačala veze među raznim narodima. Osim što će istražiti Agathinu prošlost, sir David će se baviti fascinantnom poviješću zemalja koje je posjetila. Otkrit će kako se situacija promijenila u sto godina od njezina putovanja i vidjet će kako se različite zajednice bore sa složenim nasljeđem kolonijalizma te kako ga transformiraju. programme.desc: Silent rogue - (Doc. Film, Croatia, 2023) The story of Virgili Bride, one of the greatest Croatian graphic artist painters. He was born in the village of Kolo near Tomislavgrad. It is an artist who has declared French art criticism one of the largest graphics of the 20th century. His works are exhibited in all relevant world museums - from France, Japan, Belgium, the United Kingdom, Germany, Switzerland, across the US and Canada. He was friends with great literary sizes and Nobel ladies such as Pablo Neruda, Ezra Pound, Samuel Beckett, Andrea de Richaud, Dragutin Tadijanovic, Zlatko Tomicic, Zvonimir Balog, Pierra Seghers. programme.title: Ćiribirs / Ćiribirci
programme.desc: Ćiribirje - (Doc. Film, Croatia, 2006) In the documentary "Ćiribirje" Tanja Kanceljak we will lead you through perhaps the least known part of Croatia. Cyribrians or Istor -Romania are a small linguistic group living in Istria. In the north, we will meet the Ciribirians in the village of Zejana, while on the southern slopes of Učka they live in Susnjevica and the surrounding villages. The Zupan people say they speak the female, and in Susnjevica they say they speak Vlach. Despite the small differences, we can say that it is one language, Istor -Romanian. But they have a common origin that has not yet been sufficiently explored. The version is many. The most likely one is that they arrived in Istria in the 14th century, fleeing in front of the Turks. Ciriberians were cattlemen and nomads, and over the centuries they merged with the local population. They brought with them a language that, although without a written trace, has remained in everyday use to this day. Interestingly, the speakers of the Istrorumanjski do not feel a minority or the Romanian diaspora, declared either Croats or regionally. According to UNESCO data, there are about a thousand Ciribirians in the world today, while only two hundred are left in Croatia. Apart from a few poems and traditions of bell -winning in Žejan, they do not have their own literature and art. They were left only language and they are a great and significant specialty for Istria and Croatia today. In the documentary Fima "Ciriborica", recorded in 2006, a life of people are shown that many in Croatia do not know exist. The team of Croatian Television toured them from oblivion. R .: Tanja Kanceljak ... / Ćiribirci - (dok. film, Hrvatska, 2006) U dokumentarnom filmu "Ćiribirci" Tanje Kanceljak provest ćemo vas kroz možda najmanje poznati dio Hrvatske. Ćiribirci ili Istrorumunji mala su jezična skupina koja živi u Istri. Na sjeveru ćemo Ćiribirce susresti u selu Žejane, dok na južnim padinama Učke žive u Šušnjevici i okolnim selima. Žejanci kažu kako govore žejanski, a u Šušnjevici kažu kako govore vlaški. Unatoč malim razlikama, možemo reći kako je to jedan jezik, istrorumunjski. No zajedničko im je porijeklo koje još uvijek nije dovoljno istraženo. Verzija je mnogo. Najvjerojatnija je ona da su u Istru stigli u 14. stoljeću bježeći pred Turcima. Ćiribirci su bili stočari i nomadi, a tijekom stoljeća stopili su se s domaćim stanovništvom. Sa sobom su donijeli jezik koji je, iako bez pisanog traga, i do danas ostao u svakodnevnoj uporabi. Zanimljivo je da se govornici istrorumunjskog ne osjećaju manjinom, ali niti rumunjskom dijasporom, deklariraju se ili kao Hrvati ili regionalno. Prema podacima UNESCO-a, Ćiribiraca u svijetu danas ima oko tisuću, dok ih je u Hrvatskoj ostalo samo dvjestotinjak. Osim nekoliko pjesama i tradicije zvončarstva u Žejanama, oni nemaju svoju književnost i umjetnost. Ostao im je jedino jezik i oni su danas za Istru i Hrvatsku velika i značajna posebnost. U dokumentarnom fimu "Ćiribirci", snimljenom 2006., prikazan je život ljudi za koje mnogi u Hrvatskoj i ne znaju da postoje. Od zaborava ih je istrgnula ekipa Hrvatske televizije. Kanjoni Mala i Velika Paklenica, blizanci izdubljeni vodom njezinih potoka koji se za velikih kiša i otopljenih snjegova žure prema moru. Mala Paklenica duga je dvanaest kilometara, široka četiristo do petsto metara, a Velika je duža dva kilometra. Ova dojmljiva kanjonska ljepota, bogatstvo i raznolikost šuma izvorišta bujičnih potoka Velike i Male Paklenice, proglašena je 1949. godine Nacionalnim parkom Paklenica na 95 četvornih kilometara površine. U zapadnom dijelu Parka Ribnička vrata, Javornik i Debelo brdo dominiraju iznad visoravni Velikog Rujna i Bojinca. Preko vrha Golić koji se nadvio nad Suhom dragom, udolinom Brezimenjača i u njoj skrivenim Ramićima i Parićima pogled nam seže prema sjevernoj granici nad kojom dominiraju Veli Golić, Malovan i Crljeni kuk. Iznad skrivenog i teško dostupnog kanjona potoka Male Paklenice stoje Jerkovac i Badalj s Velikim močilima. Preko Jerkovca iznad Ivanjske lokve po kosi Debelog brda penjemo se na mitsko Sveto brdo. Imati ga uz sebe, zvati ga svojim, pričati o njemu i družiti se s njim, povlastica je rijetkih. Pogled sa Svetoga brda svjedoči nam o veličini i pokazuje nam put kroz vrijeme u kojemu smo na trenutak zastali. U Ramićima smo osjetili tragove prošlih vremena. Na izvoru Stražbenica krenuli smo putem vode Golubinki. Slijedili smo njezin podzemni put u vruljama Modrič i Zečica. Pratili smo ćudljivi tok vode Velike Paklenice kroz godišnja doba. U Manitoj peći rasplamsali smo maštu. Od tisuću zabilježenih biljnih vrsta 79 ih je endemično. Penjači uz litice dijele mjesto s divokozama (Rupicapra rupicapra). Od razine mora pa do najviših visova u Nacionalnom parku Paklenica mnoge su životinjske vrste našle svoj dom. R.: Miro Andrić Ul.: Miljenko Kokot (Narrator)...

programme.title: Photos in Croatia / Fotografija u Hrvatskoj
programme.desc: Photo in Croatia - (Artistic Program, Croatia, 2013) The charismatic oeuvre of Brkan brothers, two true greats of contemporary Croatian photographs, are the foundation of the so -called. Zadar schools of photography. Older brother Ante (1918-2004) in 1951 opens a photographic studio in Zadar. For the whole treasure trove of masterful works, he should not have traveled to unknown and exotic countries, seek sophisticated and aesthetic motives. He creates his works on the threshold of the family home and in the "calet" of his city. The value of these photos, far ahead of his time, was difficult to recognize at the time as a true masterpiece. Only when there were numerous awards at international photographic salons in the world, did we dare to say that the photo could be something completely different, that the topic was irrelevant, and the motive was just an external form for multiple mean layers ... / Fotografija u Hrvatskoj - (umjetnički program, Hrvatska, 2013) Karizmatski opusi braće Brkan, dvojice istinskih velikana suvremene hrvatske fotografije, temelj su tzv. zadarske škole fotografije. Stariji brat Ante (1918.-2004.) godine 1951. otvara fotografski atelijer u Zadru. Za cijelu riznicu majstorskih djela nije trebao putovati u nepoznate i egzotične zemlje, tražiti sofisticirane i estetizirane motive. Svoja djela on stvara na pragu obiteljskog doma i po "kaletama" svoga grada. Vrijednost tih fotografija, daleko ispred svoga vremena, bilo je tada teško prepoznati kao istinska remek-djela. Tek kada su na međunarodnim fotografskim salonima u svijetu osvojile brojne nagrade, usudili smo se ustvrditi da fotografija može biti i nešto sasvim drugo, da je tema nebitna, a motiv tek vanjska forma za mnogostruke značenjske slojeve...

programme.title: Talk for a reason / Razgovor s razlogom
programme.desc: Talking for a reason - (artistic program, Croatia) The guest is one of the most important and widely read French writers Leila Slimani. Honestly and without hesitation, he will explain to us why identity perceives as a moral and ethical question. How did she answer the question - who am I? What detects us more, our social status or national identity? Why was her own family served as an inspiration for the trilogy "in the country of others" and why did she decide to tell that story of Morocco? How to look at the immigrant policy of the European Union and what are the mistakes of integration? Why doesn't it matter that others love her? What is it like to live in the country of others is a question that gives us a reason to talk to Leil Slimani. R.: Sinisa Hajduk ... / Razgovor s razlogom - (umjetnički program, Hrvatska) Gošća je jedna od najvažnijih i najčitanijih francuskih književnica Leila Slimani. Iskreno i bez zadrške objasnit će nam zašto identit doživljava kao moralno i etičko pitanje. Kako je sebi odgovorila na pitanje - tko sam ja? Što nas više određuje, naš socijalni status ili nacionalni identitet? Zašto joj je kao inspiracija za trilogiju "U zemlji drugih" poslužila vlastita obitelj i zašto je odlučila ispričati baš tu priču o Maroku? Kako gleda na imigrantsku politiku Europske unije i koje su greške integracije? Zašto joj nije važno da je drugi vole? Kako je živjeti u zemlji drugih, pitanje je koje nam daje razlog za razgovor s Leilom Slimani. R.: Siniša Hajduk...

programme.desc: The Simpsons - (S33, E07, crt. Series, USA, 2021) Simpsons, animated series with the longest service of broadcasting, cultural institutions with an extremely loyal and dedicated circle of fans. Intelligently written, subversively humorous and cute humorous, the series ridicules the environment, but also itself. She has won numerous awards. The Simpsons are also the current owners of two Guinnes records, the longest aired animated series and series with the most hosting stars. The Simpson family consists of: Father Homer, who works as an occupational safety inspector in a local nuclear power plant, Mother Marge, who tries to keep peace in the family, a naughty ten -year -old Bart, an intelligent saxophonist of eight -year -old Lisa and the smallest Maggie, which emotions expresses a pier. Over time, viewers met and loved the remaining rich and infrequent unusual world of characters living in Springfield.sumpsoni, designed by animator Matt Groening, first appeared in 1987. As a series of short stories in 30 seconds, Groening produced for The Tracy Ullman Show. They soon received their own series, broadcasting for the first time in the Christmas special special on December 17, 1989, and then in the regular date of January 14, 1990. R .: Mike B. Inteligentno pisana, subverzivno humoristična i simpatično duhovita, serija ismijava okolinu, ali i samu sebe. Dobitnica je brojnih nagrada. Simpsoni su uz to trenutačni vlasnici dva Guinnesova rekorda i to kao najdulje emitirana animirana serija i serija s najviše ugošćenih zvijezda. Obitelj Simpson čine: otac Homer, koji radi kao inspektor zaštite na radu u mjesnoj nuklearnoj elektrani, majka Marge, koja pokušava zadržati mir u obitelji, nestašni desetogodišnjak Bart, inteligentna saksofonistica osmogodišnja Lisa i najmanja Maggie, koja emocije izražava dudanjem. Gledatelji su s vremenom upoznali i zavoljeli preostali bogati i nerijetko neobični svijet likova koji žive u Springfieldu.Simpsoni, koje je osmislio animator Matt Groening, prvi su se put pojavili 1987. kao serija kratkih priča u 30 sekunda koje je Groening producirao za The Tracy Ullman Show. Uskoro su dobili vlastitu seriju emitiravši se prvi put u božićnom specijalu 17. prosinca 1989., a zatim i u redovnom terminu 14. siječnja 1990. Posjeduju svoju zvijezdu na holivudskoj Stazi slavnih, a 1. svibnja 2005. američka najzabavnija obitelj proslavila je tada rekordnu 350. epizodu. R.: Mike B. programme.title: Croatian water treasure / Hrvatsko vodeno blago
programme.desc: Croatian Water Treasure - (S02, E05, Doc. Series, Croatia, 2013) closest to the sky, illuminated by the sun, Milovan clouds worn winds, with thunder scars, locked snow in the wild in which only a few survive. Full of large stone blocks of desolate and impassable paths, pushed by dense forests and meadows, hidden widows and pits, North Velebit National Park with its 109 kilometers of square mystical and remembered niches to those who find peace in the listening of silence. Starting from Velika and Mali Zavizan, Rajinac, through the Hajduk and Rozan hips, we fly along the crossing of Alan and Dundovic to the end of the Premuzic track to the end to the end, to Stirovaca. Constantly thirsty for water that runs into a dark and mystical underground in which we only know some steps. Most of these waters will end their trip to the sea that mourns him. We will travel across the tops of the Velebit Breče, to pass the Premužić path, to meet the most beautiful flowers of Velebit, to peek into his animal world. Go through the water at the underground. To feel the spirit of tradition, to go with wolf traces and to witness the struggle of stone and fire. R .: Miro Andrić Ul.: Miljenko Kokot (Narrator) ... / Hrvatsko vodeno blago - (S02, E05, dok. serija, Hrvatska, 2013) Najbliži nebu, obasjan suncem, milovan oblacima nošenim vjetrovima, s ožiljcima od gromova, zaključan snjegovima u divljini u kojoj samo rijetki preživljavaju. Prepun velikih kamenih blokova pustih i neprohodnih staza, prošaran gustim šumama i livadama, skrovitim udolinama i jamama, Nacionalni park Sjeverni Velebit sa svojih 109 kilometara četvornih mistična je i sjetna niša onima koji u osluškivanju tišine pronalaze mir. Krenuvši od Velikog i Malog Zavižana, Rajinca, preko Hajdučkih i Rožanskih kukova, uzduž Premužićeve staze letimo prema prijelazu Alan i Dundović Mirovu pa do kraja, do Štirovače. Stalno žedan vode koja mu bježi u mračno i mistično podzemlje u kojemu tek neke korake znamo. Većina tih voda završit će svoje putovanje u moru koje ga oplakuje. Putovat ćemo preko vrhova presvučenih velebitskim brečama, proći Premužićevom stazom, upoznati najljepše cvjetove Velebita, zaviriti u njegov životinjski svijet. Krenuti putem vode u podzemlje. Osjetiti duh tradicije, krenuti vučjim tragovima i svjedočiti borbi kamena i vatre. R.: Miro Andrić Ul.: Miljenko Kokot (Narrator)...

programme.title: The world of jazz / Svijet jazza
programme.desc: Jazza World - (Music. A show, Croatia, 2024) As Cuba has marked American culture in its entirety, Cuban music has been registered with jazz history since his early days. Today, the Afrokuban jazz is one of his great genres and one of the two pillars of the music continent named Latin Jazz, and the pianist Gonzalo Rubalcab is among his leading representatives, but also the most famous jazz-pivnists in general. He began to show the unusual tendency of Rubalcab music at the youngest age, so as a six -year -old he played drums in the orchestra of Father Guillermo. Zarana labeled as a miracle of a child, Rubalcabs will attract the attention of one of the greatest popularizers of the Afrokububan jazz and jazz icon - Dizzy Gillespie in the mid -1980s, which will invite him to play with him. Shortly thereafter, another key encounter will happen - the one with the Conscious Charlie Haden, who will significantly mark Rubalcab's musical path. Since then, Rubalcaba will achieve a glittering record and concert career, with a number of notable release from Cuban and the wider tradition of jazz such as "Nocturni" and "Land of the Sun" album. The last major recognition of Rubalcabi arrived for the album "Skyline" from 2021, which he recorded with two jazz greats Jack Dejohnette and Ron Carter. It is accompanied by an excellent "Turning Point/Trio Dete", which was joined by a great Matt Brewer and Eric Harland. In addition to Ernest Simpson as a replacement for Harland on drums, Rubalcaba presented his impressive music in early July and at a small Roman theater in Pula ... / Svijet jazza - (glazb. emisija, Hrvatska, 2024) Kao što je Kuba obilježila američku kulturu u cijelosti, kubanska glazba upisana je u povijest jazza od njegovih ranih dana. Danas je afrokubanski jazz jedan od njegovih velikih žanrova i jedan od dva stupa glazbenog kontinenta po imenu Latin jazz, a pijanist Gonzalo Rubalcaba među njegovim je vodećim predstavnicima, ali i najpoznatijim jazz-pijanistima općenito. Neobičnu sklonost glazbi Rubalcaba je počeo pokazivati u najmlađoj dobi, pa je već kao šestogodišnjak zasvirao bubnjeve u orkestru oca Guillerma. Zarana označen kao čudo od djeteta, Rubalcaba će sredinom osamdesetih u Havani privući pažnju jednog od najvećih popularizatora afrokubanskog jazza i ikone jazza - Dizzyja Gillespieja, koji će ga pozvati da s njim zasvira. Ubrzo nakon toga dogodit će se još jedan ključan susret - onaj s konstrabasistom Charliejem Hadenom, koji će bitno obilježiti Rubalcabin glazbeni put. Otad će Rubalcaba ostvariti blistavu diskografsku i koncertnu karijeru, uz niz zapaženih izdanja izniklih iz kubanske, ali i šire tradicije jazza poput albuma "Nocturne" i "Land of the Sun". Posljednje veliko priznanje Rubalcabi je stiglo za album "Skyline" iz 2021., koji je snimio s dvama velikanima jazza Jackom DeJohnetteom i Ronom Carterom. Na njega se nadovezuje izvrsni "Turning Point/Trio Dete", na kojem su mu se pridružili sjajni Matt Brewer i Eric Harland. Uz Ernesta Simpsona kao zamjenu za Harlanda na bubnjevima, Rubalcaba je svoju impresivnu glazbu predstavio početkom srpnja i u Malom rimskom kazalištu u Puli...

programme.title: Monika Leskovar and HRT Symphony Orchestra under the direction of Pascal Rophea - KD V. Lisinski / Monika Leskovar i Simfonijski orkestar HRT-a pod ravnanjem Pascala Rophea - KD V. Lisinski
programme.desc: Monika Leskovar and HRT Symphony Orchestra under the direction of Pascal Rophea - KD V. Lisinski - (film Class. Music, Croatia, 2025) The HRT Symphony Orchestra opens the new season of the master cycle under the guidance of Maestro Pascal Rophe, which begins its second term of the chief of the Dirigent orchestra. The program begins with the Singing Song of Slava (Chant du Rossignol) Igor Stravinsky, derived from his opera Slavuj (1914). Stravinski's contemporary and countryman Sergei Rahmanjin's second symphony returned his faith in a composer call after a catastrophic failure of the first symphony of 1897 and the severe creative crisis that followed. Another symphony, intended for the large composition of the symphony orchestra, with as many as three instruments each in most width sections and an extended group of percussion, contains an abundance of beautiful, swollen romantic music, but at the same time a masterfully controlled tension that is released in the magnificent final. The concert soloist is one of our most awarded cellist, Monika Leskovar, who, as a thirteen -year -old, became the youngest winner of the International Tchaikovsky Competition in Japan (1995). Rich in international careers, today he teaches at the Academy of Music in Zagreb and always gladly returns to the HRT Symphony Orchestra, and on this occasion in the interpretation of the variation on the Rokoko Theme of Petra Iljic Tchaikovsky. Although his role model were classic forms and type of orchestra from Hayn's time, Petar Iljic Tchaikovsky created more than a virtuosic and romantic gorgeous work with a prose rococo theme and complex variations in his variations. R.: Vesna Fijac Fodor ... / Monika Leskovar i Simfonijski orkestar HRT-a pod ravnanjem Pascala Rophea - KD V. Lisinski - (film klas. glazbe, Hrvatska, 2025) Simfonijski orkestar HRT-a otvara novu sezonu Majstorskog ciklusa pod vodstvom maestra Pascala Rophea koji ovim koncertom počinje svoj drugi mandat šefa dirigenta cijenjenog orkestra. Program počinje simfonijskom pjesmom Pjev slavuja (Chant du rossignol) Igora Stravinskog, proizašlom iz njegove opere Slavuj (1914.). Stravinskijev suvremenik i zemljak Sergej Rahmanjinov Drugom simfonijom vratio je svoju vjeru u skladateljski poziv nakon katastrofalnog neuspjeha Prve simfonije 1897. i teške stvaralačke krize koja je uslijedila. Druga simfonija, namijenjena velikom sastavu simfonijskog orkestra, s čak po tri instrumenta u većini puhačkih sekcija i proširenom skupinom udaraljki, sadrži obilje predivne, nabujale romantičarske glazbe, ali i istovremeno majstorski kontroliranu napetost koja se oslobađa u veličanstvenom finalu. Solistica na koncertu je jedna od naših najnagrađivanijih violončelistica, Monika Leskovar, koja je kao trinaestogodišnjakinja postala najmlađa pobjednica Međunarodnog natjecanja Čajkovski u Japanu (1995.). Bogate međunarodne karijere, danas predaje na Muzičkoj akademiji u Zagrebu te se uvijek rado vraća pred Simfonijski orkestar HRT-a, a ovom prigodom u interpretaciji Varijacija na rokoko temu Petra Iljiča Čajkovskog. Iako su mu uzor bile klasične forme i tip orkestra iz Haydnova doba, Petar Iljič Čajkovski u svojim je Varijacijama stvorio više nego virtuozno i romantičarski raskošno djelo s prpošnom rokoko temom i kompleksnim varijacijama. R.: Vesna Fijačko Fodor...

programme.title: A masterpiece or evil / Remek-djelo ili zlodjelo
programme.desc: Fake Or Fortune - (S08, E02, Doc. Series, England, 2019) The picture speaks more than a thousand words, but these paintings narrate much more than that - the whole criminal novel! Behind the facades of fancy galleries and distinguished auction houses that trade in art, there is a dark reverse - the dark side of invaluable wealth, social ambitions, sometimes fraud ... A well -known investigator of art and historian and a series of top scientists have joined in research action to shed light on the truth behind the paintings. From Paris and Amsterdam to Cape Town, the Nile and New York coast, the team is used by traditional investigative skills and the most modern forensic methods to trace lost masterpieces, forgeries and arts that robbed the Nazis. Is the world denied one monet Museum forgery? Fiona Bruce and Philip Mold explore unusual stories behind the painting canvas and bring art to the new audience. ... / Fake or Fortune - (S08, E02, dok. serija, Engleska, 2019) Slika govori više od tisuću riječi, ali ove slike pripovijedaju još mnogo više od toga - cijele kriminalističke romane! Iza fasade otmjenih galerija i uglednih aukcijskih kuća koje trguju umjetninama krije se mračno naličje - tamna strana neprocjenjivog bogatstva, društvene ambicije, katkad i prevare...Poznati istražitelj umjetnina i povjesničar te niz vrhunskih znanstvenika udružili su se u istraživačkoj akciji kako bi rasvijetlili istinu iza slika. Od Pariza i Amsterdama do Cape Towna, obala Nila i New Yorka, ekipa se služi tradicionalnim istražiteljskim vještinama i najsuvremenijim forenzičkim metodama da uđe u trag izgubljenim remek-djelima, krivotvoriteljima i umjetninama koje su opljačkali nacisti.Je li svijet uskraćen za jednog Moneta, kako je izgubljeno djelo slavnog američkog umjetnika završilo na otpadu, je li slika u uglednom londonskom muzeju krivotvorina? Fiona Bruce i Philip Mould istražuju neobične priče iza slikarskog platna i približavaju umjetnost novoj publici. ...

programme.title: NFL / NFL
programme.desc: Follow the action -packed American Football League NFL - the world's leading sporting league in terms of audience figures and revenue. / Følg den actionfyldte amerikanske fodboldliga NFL – verdens førende sportsliga målt på publikumstal og omsætning.

programme.title: Runner Runner / Runner Runner
programme.desc: The film revolves around Richie (Justin Timberlake), a Prinston University, who pays his studies on the Internet. Richie is traveling to Costa Rica to confront the mastermind and the gambling legend on the Internet; Ivan Block (Ben Affleck), because he manipulated and deceived him. Ivan Block sees in Richie the spirit and youth that the operations need, but Ricci soon discovers and realizes the deception of Evan and turns the table on him. / تدور أحداث الفيلم حول ريتشي (جاستين تيمبرليك) طالب بجامعة برينستون الذي يقوم بدفع مصاريف دراسته عن طريق المقامرة علي الإنترنت. يسافر ريتشي إلى كوستاريكا لمواجهة العقل المدبر وأسطورة المقامرة على الإنترنت؛ إيفان بلوك (بن أفليك)، لأنه تلاعب به وخدعه. يري إيفان بلوك في ريتشي الروح والشباب اللتين تحتاجهما العمليات، ولكن سرعان ما يكتشف ريتشي ويدرك خداع إيفان ويقوم بقلب الطاولة عليه.

programme.title: Fortress: Snipers Eye / Fortress: Snipers Eye
programme.desc: Retired CIA agent Robert Carter Michaels and his son Paul are committed to rebuilding their relationship after spending their last epic encounter protecting the highly secure secret base known as The Citadel. But when Paul's wife Melissa is kidnapped, he and Robert embark on a deadly journey through rugged mountains in hopes of rescuing her before time runs out. / التزم عميل وكالة المخابرات المركزية المتقاعد روبرت كارتر مايكلز وابنه بول بإعادة بناء علاقتهما بعد أن قضيا آخر لقاء ملحمي في حماية القاعدة السرية شديدة الأمان والمعروفة باسم (القلعة). ولكن عندما تُختطف ميليسا زوجة بول، يشرع هو وروبرت في رحلة مميتة عبر الجبال الوعرة على أمل إنقاذها قبل نفاد الوقت.

programme.title: Winchester / Winchester
programme.desc: Based on a true story, the events revolve around (Sarah), Mrs. Ghariba, and the heir of the weapons maker (Oliver Winchester), believing that she is chased by angry spirits of people who were killed by Winchster rifles. programme.desc: The giant Sakatoch (Cooper) leaves his home in the city to go into a new adventure in the woods, where he meets (Bobby) and becomes friends and go through adventures to get to know the beautiful wildlife. / يترك الساسكواتش العملاق (كوبر) منزله في المدينة ليخوض مغامرة جديدة في الغابة، حيث يقابل (بوبي) ويصبحان صديقين ويخوضان مغامرات للتعرف على الحياة البرية الجميلة.

programme.title: Edmond and Lucy / Edmond and Lucy
programme.desc: The events revolve around the squirrel (Edmund) and the bear (Lucy), who live an adventurous life in their home in the forest, where nature is their best playmate. / تدور الأحداث حول السنجاب (إدموند) والدبة (لوسي)، واللذين يعيشان حياة مليئة بالمغامرات في منزلهما في الغابة، حيث تكون الطبيعة هي أفضل رفيقة لهما في اللعب.

programme.title: Santiago of the Seas / Santiago of the Seas
programme.desc: The work is followed by Santiago, a 8 -year -old pirate, and his crew shining in rescue operations, discovering hidden treasures and maintaining the high Caribbean sea. / يتبع العمل سانتياجو، وهو قرصان يبلغ من العمر 8 سنوات، وطاقمه وهم يشرعون في عمليات الإنقاذ واكتشاف الكنوز المخبأة والحفاظ على أعالي البحر الكاريبي آمنًا.

programme.title: PAW Patrol S6 / PAW Patrol S6
programme.desc: In this season, the puppies intervene to restore three of their ice carriers away from their home, and the disappearance of honey from the town causes everyone to panic, before the mayor is attached to a valley in remote mountains, and needs quick intervention. / في هذا الموسم تتدخل الجراء لإعادة ثلاثة بطاريق حملهم الجليد بعيدًا عن منزلهم، ويتسبب اختفاء العسل من البلدة في هلع الجميع، قبل أن يعلق العمدة في وادٍ بالجبال النائية، ويحتاج لتدخل سريع.

programme.title: Gus the Itsy Bitsy Knight / Gus the Itsy Bitsy Knight
programme.desc: The little boy (Gas) wants to become the greatest knight in the entire kingdom, then tries to prove to everyone that he can overcome everything, and for this, it is for that; Many exciting and interesting adventures. / يريد الولد الصغير (غس) أن يصبح أعظم فارس في المملكة بأكملها، ثم يحاول أن يثبت للجميع أنه يمكنه التغلب على كل شيء، وفي سبيل ذلك؛ يخوض العديد من المغامرات المثيرة والشيقة.

programme.title: Bahar / Bahar
programme.desc: The life of the housewife (Bahar), full of disappointments, becomes a new meaning when she returns from death, and it is decided to complete her dream that she abandoned, and to confront the society that he considered dead. / تصبح حياة ربة المنزل (بهار) المليئة بخيبات الأمل ذات معنى جديد حين تعود من الموت، وتُقرر استكمال حلمها الذي تخلت عنه، ومواجهة المجتمع الذي اعتبرها ميتة.

programme.title: FAR CITY / Uzak Sehir
programme.desc: A woman arrives with her son to her late husband's homeland to bury his body and leave in peace, but his influential family prevents her from leaving and fights occur that reveal many dark secrets. / تصل امرأة مع ابنها إلى موطن زوجها الراحل لدفن جثمانه والمغادرة بسلام، لكن عائلته ذات النفوذ تمنعها من المغادرة وتحدث معارك تُظهر الكثير من الأسرار المظلمة.

programme.title: Family Secrets / Family Secrets
programme.desc: The work is taking place in a dramatic framework, where a lawyer and prosecutor must work together to investigate a murder to find the killer, which creates an irreversible collapse in their lives. / يدور العمل في إطار درامي، حيث يتعين على محامي ومدعي العام العمل معًا بالتحقيق في جريمة قتل للعثور على القاتل، مما يخلق نقطة انهيار لا رجعة فيها في حياتهما.

programme.title: Except I am 2 / إلا أنا ج2
programme.desc: A drama inspired by life stories. Each story is presented in ten episodes that discusses issues of concern to society in general and women’s issues in particular, and revolves around several stories, including (The House of Glory), (My Story with Time), and (A Taste of the World). / دراما مستوحاة من قصص الحياة، كل قصة تقدم في عشر حلقات تناقش قضايا تهم المجتمع بصفة عامة وقضايا المرأة بصفة خاصة، وتدور في عدة حكايات منها (بيت العز) و(حكايتي مع الزمان) و(طعم الدنيا).

programme.title: Client / العميل
programme.desc: The story of the series revolves around two brothers, Amir and Wissam, who have been separated by fate since childhood. Amir grows up to become a police officer, but joins a gang as part of a secret operation. While his brother Wissam, who was kidnapped when he was a child, grows up to become part of the same gang. Unbeknownst to them, the two brothers work together without knowing their true selves, and their fates are intertwined in a thrilling, suspense-filled setting. / تدور قصة المسلسل حول الأخوين أمير ووسام الذين يفرقهما القدر منذ الصغر، يكبر أمير ليصبح ضابط شرطة، لكنه ينضم لعصابة كجزء من عملية سرية. بينما أخوه وسام، الذي اختطف عندما كان طفلاً، يكبر ليصبح جزءً من نفس العصابة. بدون علمهما، يعمل الأخوان معًا دون معرفة حقيقتهما، ويتشابك مصيرهما في إطار مثير مليء بالتشويق.

Unbeknownst to them, the two brothers work together without knowing their true selves, and their fates are intertwined in a thrilling, suspense-filled setting. / تدور قصة المسلسل حول الأخوين أمير ووسام الذين يفرقهما القدر منذ الصغر، يكبر أمير ليصبح ضابط شرطة، لكنه ينضم لعصابة كجزء من عملية سرية. بينما أخوه وسام، الذي اختطف عندما كان طفلاً، يكبر ليصبح جزءً من نفس العصابة. بدون علمهما، يعمل الأخوان معًا دون معرفة حقيقتهما، ويتشابك مصيرهما في إطار مثير مليء بالتشويق.

programme.title: Secret Part 2: Challenge / سر ج2: التحدي
programme.desc: The battle of Amer Badran begins after leaving the imprisonment to confront the investigator Jad again, and to work with the Don in the trading of the prohibitions for the escalation of events. / تبدأ معركة عامر بدران بعد خروجه من الحبس لمواجهة المحقق جاد من جديد، والعمل مع الدون في تجارة الممنوعات لتتصاعد الأحداث.

programme.title: Except I am 2 / إلا أنا ج2
programme.desc: A drama inspired by life stories. Each story is presented in ten episodes that discusses issues of concern to society in general and women’s issues in particular, and revolves around several stories, including (The House of Glory), (My Story with Time), and (A Taste of the World). / دراما مستوحاة من قصص الحياة، كل قصة تقدم في عشر حلقات تناقش قضايا تهم المجتمع بصفة عامة وقضايا المرأة بصفة خاصة، وتدور في عدة حكايات منها (بيت العز) و(حكايتي مع الزمان) و(طعم الدنيا).

programme.title: Inheritance C3 / الميراث ج3
programme.desc: Overnight, the conditions change in this part, as Haifa returns to appear again, Youssef decides to return his accounts and marry and forgive them, while the fires between Dima and Majid are burning and the divorce occurs between them, and the magic of revenge was decided by everyone who caused the death of her son. / ما بين ليلة وضحاها تتبدل الأحوال في هذ الجزء، فمع عودة هيفاء للظهور مرة أخرى يقرر يوسف إعادة حساباته والزواج منها ومسامحتها، في حين تشتعل النيران بين ديما وماجد ويقع الطلاق بينهما، وتقرر سحر الانتقام من كل من تسبب في وفاة ابنها.

programme.title: Bahar / Bahar
programme.desc: The life of the housewife (Bahar), full of disappointments, takes on a new meaning when she returns from the dead, and decides to complete the dream she abandoned, and confront the society that considered her dead. / تصبح حياة ربة المنزل (بهار) المليئة بخيبات الأمل ذات معنى جديد حين تعود من الموت، وتُقرر استكمال حلمها الذي تخلت عنه، ومواجهة المجتمع الذي اعتبرها ميتة.

programme.title: Far City / Uzak Sehir
programme.desc: A woman arrives with her son to the home of her late husband to bury his body and leave in peace, but his influential family prevents her from leaving and causes battles showing many dark secrets. / تصل امرأة مع ابنها إلى موطن زوجها الراحل لدفن جثمانه والمغادرة بسلام، لكن عائلته ذات النفوذ تمنعها من المغادرة وتحدث معارك تُظهر الكثير من الأسرار المظلمة.

programme.title: Family Secrets / Family Secrets
programme.desc: The work takes place in a dramatic context, as a lawyer and a prosecutor must work together to investigate a murder to find the killer, creating an irreversible breaking point in their lives. / يدور العمل في إطار درامي، حيث يتعين على محامي ومدعي العام العمل معًا بالتحقيق في جريمة قتل للعثور على القاتل، مما يخلق نقطة انهيار لا رجعة فيها في حياتهما.

programme.title: Whole number +1 / كامل العدد +1

programme.title: Oh God, I am fasting / اللهم إني صايم
programme.desc: The story of the series “Oh God, I am fasting” revolves around “Ali Abu Al Karamat” (Mustafa Shaban). “Ali” lived throughout his life spoiled by his mother and is not punished for his mistakes, so he grew up to become an unpleasant person, always lies and never says the truth and everyone around him knows his lie. "Ali" begins to exploit his talent in that lies in order to make money, and he will set up some of the big businessmen. "Ali" believes that the people of the people must be taken from their money to the poor, but businessmen begin to reveal his monument, and it is chased by businessmen in addition to the police. What will happen in that chase? Is Ali arrested or found businessmen to take revenge on him, or can he escape? / تدور احداث قصة مسلسل “اللهم إني صائم” حول “على ابو الكرامات” (مصطفى شعبان) , عاش “علي” طوال حياته مدلل من والدته و لا يتم عقابه على اخطائه , فكبر ليصبح انسان غير سوي , دائمًا ما يكذب و لا يقول الحقيقة ابدًا و كل من حوله يعرفون كذبه . يبدأ “علي” استغلال موهبته في الكذب تلك من اجل جني المال , فيقوم بالنصب على بعض رجال الاعمال الكبار . يؤمن “علي” بان اولائك الاشخاص يجب ان يؤخذ من مالهم للفقراء , و لكن يبدأ رجال الاعمال في كشف نصبه, و يطارده رجال الاعمال اولائك بالاضافة الى الشرطة . ماذا سيحدث في تلك المطاردة ؟. هل يتم القبض على “علي” او يعثر عليه رجال الاعمال لينتقموا منه ام يستطيع الهروب ؟.
